claim_boundary: v117 generates explicit helium-channel overlays and solves nominal and 50-percent-flow axial energy graphs at three mesh levels through the v94 registry and whole-graph assembler. Gnielinski heat transfer, Petukhov smooth-tube friction, a 20-percent one-sided heat-transfer derating, coolant pumping power and source-pinned EUROFER temperature limits are evaluated candidate-by-candidate. A pass is a one-dimensional lumped channel screen, not 3D conjugate CFD, manifold/maldistribution qualification, irradiation damage, LOCA safety, component certification or whole-device evidence.
